name: gemm_epilogue
summary: Fused GEMM + BiasAdd (+ optional ReLU). C = (A @ B) + bias, then optionally ReLU at epilogue. Supports f32 naive strided and f16 WMMA tensor-core out_f16 (requires C contiguous row-major). Bias is 1D length N with stride_valid; f16 path assumes bias dtype f16.
contract: - strides must be valid (>0) for all tensors (strided allowed)
- f16 TC path: A,B,Bias,C all f16 (WMMA accumulator is f32 internally, stored to f16)
- transA/transB control logical 2D views without physically transposing
- relu toggles epilogue activation (default enabled in v0)
- y = acc[m,n] + Bias[n] (Bias index uses its stride)
Extra constraint for f16 TC variant:
- C must be contiguous row-major (stride[1]==1 and stride[0]==shape[1])
- Bias contiguous is recommended but NOT required in v0 (only stride_valid>0 is required)
abi: - schema_id==0 => default transA=0, transB=0, relu=1 (Bias+ReLU default)
- If schema_id is neither 0 nor 'GPEL' => treat as defaults
notes: Bias indexing uses Bias[(int64_t)col * Bs], where Bs is Bias.stride[0].
f16 TC variant uses WMMA 16x16 tiles. A is packed row-major; B is packed col-major into shared memory; accumulate in f32 then add bias and apply ReLU at store.
WMMA path pads K to ceil16(K) with zero-fill loads (out-of-bounds loads return 0).
C contig row-major is required for TC path selection; f32 path supports arbitrary positive strides.

variants.name: gemm_bias_relu_f32_naive_strided
supported: A,B,C: strides valid (>0 for both dims)
Attr: schema_id in {0,'GPEL'} or anything else (treated as default)
After applying transA/transB: A_view=[M,K], B_view=[K,N], C=[M,N]
notes: Per element: K-loop accumulate, add bias, optional ReLU, store.

variants.name: gemm_bias_relu_f16_tc_wmma_out_f16_strided
supported: A,B,C: strides valid (>0 for both dims)
After applying transA/transB: A_view=[M,K], B_view=[K,N], C=[M,N]
TC requirement: C is contiguous row-major (stride[1]==1 && stride[0]==C.shape[1])
notes: Compute: WMMA accumulate (f32), then epilogue does +bias and optional ReLU before storing f16.
K padded to ceil16(K) with zero-fill loads.

experiments.title: Optionally require Bias contiguous in TC path
experiments.change: Enable the commented gating: require Bias stride==1 for f16 TC variant.
experiments.why: Non-contig bias implies strided loads for every output element; can hurt bandwidth and complicate vectorization.
experiments.hypothesis: Slight throughput gain for large N when bias is contiguous; clearer expectations for fused epilogue.
experiments.proof: Benchmark TC variant with Bias stride=1 vs stride>1; ncu global load efficiency for bias.
experiments.next: If keeping stride support, consider caching bias tile in shared memory per CTA.

experiments.title: Vectorize epilogue store (bias+relu) for f16 path
experiments.change: Store f16 outputs in vector packs (half2/half4) and fuse bias loads similarly when C is contiguous row-major.
experiments.why: Current WMMA store loop writes scalars; vectorization can improve memory coalescing and reduce instruction count.
experiments.hypothesis: Higher effective GB/s and lower latency for large M,N.
experiments.proof: ncu: global store transactions per request, achieved bandwidth; correctness vs reference.
experiments.next: Add alignment gating and ensure bias addressing supports vector loads when stride==1.

experiments.title: Extend epilogue: bias + activation family
experiments.change: Generalize relu flag into an activation enum (none/relu/gelu/silu) and optionally add scale (alpha) support.
experiments.why: Epilogue fusion is the main win path for inference; having a richer epilogue avoids extra elementwise kernels.
experiments.hypothesis: Fewer launches and better end-to-end throughput on transformer MLP blocks.
experiments.proof: Measure graph-level speedup on MLP: GEMM+Bias+Act vs GEMM_epilogue fused; validate numerics.
experiments.next: Define new AttrBlob schema v1 with activation enum and parameters; keep v0 backward compatible.

measurements.notes: Report latency and achieved TFLOP/s (2*M*N*K ops). Compare against unfused GEMM + bias_add + relu chain.
